result.title: dit.xpu : Taming DiT Sparse Inference on Mobile SoCs
result.summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable on-device image generation and editing but incur high attention costs at high resolutions. Existing sparse attention reduces computation, yet dynamic sparsity introduces preprocessing and irregular data accesses that poorly fit mobile NPUs. We present DiT.XPU, a sparse DiT inference framework for heterogeneous mobile SoCs. DiT.XPU combines tile-aligned sparse attention with anchor-based error compensation by exploiting slowly varying dense-sparse output residuals across denoising steps. Heterogeneous XPU collaboration overlaps NPU dense attention with GPU sparse calibration, while mask-guided dataflow reduces data transfers and layout conversion by overlapping data movement with computation. Across five DiT models on two Snapdragon smartphones, DiT.XPU achieves up to 1.56x end-to-end denoising speedup over the Hexagon-NPU backend and 11.5x attention-kernel speedup over the fastest alternative, while preserving generation quality close to dense attention. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/dit.xpu.

AI.brief_summary: 面向移动 SoC 提出 DiT.XPU 稀疏推理框架，结合 tile 对齐稀疏注意力、基于锚点的误差补偿与 NPU/GPU 异构协作，加速扩散Transformer 图像生成去噪。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作核心是图像生成模型的注意力稀疏化与移动端硬件调度，未涉及视觉推理中的内部状态表示、证据使用或停止决策，也未给出可供 LVR 核查的状态更新或贡献分配线索，故排除。
